title: Evidence export summary
description: summary.json in an evidence/v1 export: counts and the head of the exported chain. Not expressible here and checked by the verifier: the file is the canonical JSON form; last_sequence equals records; records, denied, head_record_hash and terminal_state re-derive from records.ndjson; terminal_state is present exactly when ended is true; a sealed chain has ended; the file is at most 1 MiB.

export_version.description: The export layout version; 1 in evidence/v1.

first_sequence.description: Always 1: an export holds the chain from its first record.

denied.description: Number of records whose action_outcome is denied.

terminal_state.description: Present exactly when ended is true.

sealed.description: True when the chain ends with a seal record after the terminal record.

digest.description: A SHA-256 digest: the prefix sha256: and 64 lowercase hex characters.
